articles.title: Keeping Time vs. Understanding Time: Neither Alone Explains Temporal Reasoning in LLMs
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.29507v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Temporal reasoning is widely assumed to decompose into two modes: temporal arithmetic (date and time calculations), and temporal semantics (understanding temporal and causal relations). This dichotomy shapes how benchmarks are designed, how models are trained, and how progress is measured, yet its empirical validity has never been directly tested. We provide two lines of evidence that challenge it. First, we test whether tasks labelled as arithmetic or semantic by the benchmarks support transferable gains within their purported mode. Finetuning on these subsets yields predominantly dataset-specific gains ($+6.8$ to $+23.1$ percentage points), while transfer to a different dataset in the same mode ranges from $-3.2$ to $+1.1$ percentage points. Across the two benchmark families used in the transfer analysis, this pattern provides little evidence of coherent, transferable temporal abilities. Second, using cognitive-demand-based model evaluation, we examine which capabilities actually drive performance on these benchmarks. We find that quantitative and logical reasoning, the assumed proxies for temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics, are not the primary drivers; knowledge is. Together, these findings show that current temporal reasoning benchmarks do not cleanly realise the arithmetic-semantics distinction and instead largely reward models for remembering how time typically works.

articles.title: Introducing Agent Compute Engine and expanded agent governance
articles.text:
Blog authors: Nirav Mehta, VP Product Management; Michael Bachman, VP/GM; Kevin Hutchins, VP Product Management
Scaling Gemini to planet scale taught us firsthand that securely running autonomous agents is fundamentally an infrastructure challenge. The shift from single-turn prompting to interactive agents requires a new paradigm of execution and control. To support massive concurrent agent sessions, we engineered new compute and governance solutions for Gemini to help solve these challenges.
Today at AGNTCon + MCPCon, we are delivering these capabilities to customers by launching Agent Compute Engine, a purpose-built compute service that already powers Gemini as an agent for work tasks. It will be available in preview in the coming months, providing hardware-isolated runtime sandbox security. Additionally, we are extending Gemini for business’ agent governance capabilities to support agents wherever they operate. Together, these capabilities deliver the control you need to run, govern, and scale your agents.
Under the hood of Agent Compute Engine
Agent Compute Engine arose from the need to handle Google’s massive agentic workloads that write and execute code, run tools, drive browsers, orchestrate enterprise workflows, and iterate rapidly and at scale. While traditional compute primitives are excellent for standard workloads, they weren't optimized for the unique, highly iterative nature of AI agents.
Purpose-built for agents, Agent Compute Engine gives every Gemini agent its own high-performance, secure computer to act upon, powering Gemini's dynamic, high-churn sessions. Agent Compute Engine is optimized specifically for the unique lifecycle patterns of AI agents, and you will soon be able to use this service to power your own custom agents. Highlights include:
Speed with efficiency: Agents start, pause, and resume constantly and require an architecture that delivers speed, at scale, all with extreme efficiency. Agent Compute Engine delivers microVMs that boot rapidly, so an agent loop or an eval sweep doesn’t wait on infrastructure. Further, supporting Google users with multiple agents requires a cost-effective solution that can get the most out of a physical machine. Agent Compute Engine achieves this by using copy-on-write memory sharing to run multiple agents on a single operating system template, and pausing idle microVMs via fast checkpoint and restore. When an agent finishes executing a tool call and enters the “thinking” phase of the agentic loop, the microVM signals that it's idle, and the host moves it from an active to an idle state. In other words, it can pause a running microVM while an agent waits on a human or an external system, and quickly resume it from snapshots.
Enhanced security, isolation and governance: As agents take on more complex tasks, the risk of untrusted or adversarial code executing inside a sandbox is an ever-present reality. By running Agent Compute Engine with Titanium, Google’s offload infrastructure processing unit (IPU), we deliver silicon-rooted defense-in-depth built for untrusted AI agents. Agent Compute Engine delivers strong isolation via a hardware-isolated Cloud Hypervisor boundary with its own guest kernel and root access. (For a closer look at Agent Compute Engine’s microVM architecture and security, read the technical deep dive.) Each microVM runs its agent’s own identity, using short-lived credentials. Every microVM also gets its own cryptographically verified ID, and service credentials are injected in egress outside the microVM. Integrated with Agent Gateway, Agent Compute Engine delivers comprehensive observability, policy and security evaluation.
Persistence and enterprise integration: Agents require the ability to persist agent data across multiple, long-running sessions. To solve this, each Agent Compute Engine microVM has its own Hyperdisk, enabling persistence of execution workspaces and agent context. In addition, in order to do meaningful work, they need the ability to use enterprise data without moving it. By weaving Agent Compute Engine directly into Google’s cloud and identity fabric, enterprise connectivity is governed by the exact same security and identity model that protects the microVM itself, enabling a unified identity model as well as auditability.
"Scaling the Gemini agent to planet scale requires compute that spins up rapidly and operates with extreme efficiency. Agent Compute Engine microVMs give us the responsiveness, hardware isolation, and workload density needed to deliver interactive agent sandboxes to our users around the world." - Gautham Thambidorai, VP & Google Fellow, Gemini
Building on GKE with Agent Substrate
For platform teams looking for customization and multi-cloud portability, or who have already standardized on Kubernetes, Agent Substrate on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) is an open-source execution runtime that brings the same agent-first design to Kubernetes. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture that cleanly decouples agent execution from machine management. When an agent becomes idle, Agent Substrate snapshots its active memory and returns the machine to the pool, then resumes the agent the moment it’s needed again. Because it’s open source and Kubernetes-native, you can customize it, extend it, and run it alongside your existing workloads. Some Agent Substrate highlights include:
High-density: Agent Substrate delivers as much as 10x higher compute density compared to traditional compute while maintaining full kernel isolation and identity-based network security for every agent.
Sub-second activation: In benchmark validation running 200,000 agents, Agent Substrate sustained 500 activations per second at less than 500 ms suspend and resume latency.
Security by default: Think of Agent Substrate as zero-trust for agents. Each sandbox has strong hardware isolation built in using your choice of microVM or gVisor and every agent gets its own cryptographically secure identity paired with egress proxies that enforce granular network policies and inject credentials outside the reach of the agents themselves. Looking ahead, we will expand the Agent Substrate runtime architecture to integrate with our broader Gemini for business governance framework.
Open source portability: Runs on any Kubernetes cluster in any compute environment and works with any agent framework or harness, including Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes.
Dynamic storage: Integrates with Filestore agent volumes with sub-second resume latency to scale alongside active compute, providing a single shared workspace for multi-agent workflows.
Leading AI teams like Nous Research are already using this reliable architecture to deploy multi-tenant agents directly into existing customer infrastructure efficiently.
“We built Hermes Enterprise to enable customers to deploy into their existing infrastructure, while handling per-agent isolation and extensible access control. Agent Substrate addresses both at the platform layer in a way that also preserves valuable compute resources. Our experience with Agent Substrate gives us confidence the architecture can scale efficiently as agent workloads grow.” - Hervé Bizira, Chief Business Officer, Nous Research
Expanding governance capabilities for agents everywhere
As organizations transition autonomous agents from isolated pilots to multi-runtime production fleets, traditional security frameworks must be hardened and evolve. Customers face a triple challenge: securing dynamic non-deterministic interaction paths across agents, tools, models, skills and data; maintaining a default deny posture with least-privilege-access distributed runtimes; and ensuring that asynchronous agent actions can be audited. Without strong agent governance, agent sprawl quickly introduces risk — including shadow AI, data exfiltration, and agent actions that are hard to track and audit.
To solve these challenges, we built robust agent governance capabilities into Gemini platform, including:
Agent Gateway: Serves as the air traffic controller for client-to-agent and agents-to-anywhere traffic. It integrates a broad set of governance and security policies including sensitive data protection, agent attack protection, semantic governance, and the ability to bring your own policy.
Agent Registry: Provides a central repository that serves as the source of truth for all approved running agents, tools, MCP servers, skills, models and endpoints, governing runtime access via applied policies.
Agent Identity: Assigns a unique secure ID using open standard based SPIFFE to each agent, acting as the digital signature for authentication, access control, and auditing.
Agent observability: Provides OpenTelemetry (OTel)-compliant telemetry adopting agentic semantic conventions, emitting standardized metrics, logs, and distributed traces for every model call, tool invocation, and agent hop across Agent Gateway.
Now as agent fleets continue to grow dramatically across diverse environments, we are extending the reach of our Gemini for business agent governance capabilities across Google Cloud runtimes, cross-cloud, on-prem and client devices to manage and secure agents everywhere they run. This includes the following capabilities:
Broad Google Cloud runtime coverage: Extends comprehensive agent governance across Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, Agent Sandboxes in Gemini platform, GKE, and Agent Compute Engine (preview).
Consistent cross-cloud reach: Deploys lightweight, Envoy proxy-based policy enforcement points to extend governance to multicloud and hybrid environments (in preview soon).
Governance for local agents on endpoints: Extends governance to coding agents like Claude Code and Antigravity CLI on managed devices with an OS-level sandbox and local governance services (in preview soon).
Additionally we are announcing new agent governance capabilities to Agent Gateway to enable granular cost controls, intelligent model routing, and simplified customizations and integrations. Highlights coming this quarter in preview include:
Granular token and cost governance: Token management provides control over token consumption across agents and models, allowing you to attribute spend, enforce budget guardrails, and provide a single source of truth for token metrics.
Route requests to the right model: Model routing policies route user and agent requests to the right model, controlling costs and improving performance.
Extensible policies: Service Extensions bindings add streamlined support for inline programmability and extensibility. Allows tightly integrating Google services, customers’ bespoke functions, and partner services directly into the datapath.
Expanded security partner ecosystem: Provides delegated user authorization with third-party identity providers Ping Identity, SailPoint, and Saviynt; in addition to secure Oauth using Agent Identity auth manager. Our extensive list of integration partners is here.
Simplified and secure agent-to-tool connectivity: Express Link for Cloud Run allows agents to declare what they need to reach, and it establishes the secure, authenticated connection between components, including identity token injection.
“At L’Oréal, our ambition is to put agentic AI in the hands of our teams, empowering them to bring new ideas to life and shape the future of beauty. Through our Beauty Tech Agentic Platform, AI agents are becoming part of everyday work. Google Cloud’s agent governance provides us the foundation to scale this ambition with confidence, unifying identity, policy and observability across runtimes such as Cloud Run. Our developers can innovate faster while we maintain clear control over what each agent can access.” - Alexandre Frizzo, AI Lead Engineer, L’Oreal
Build on our resilient agent infrastructure
The agentic era requires an evolution in how we scale infrastructure. By combining the high-performance execution of Agent Compute Engine and Agent Substrate with agent governance capabilities from Gemini for business — now expanded with cross-cloud reach — we are establishing a resilient foundation for protected, high-density AI agents.
Learn more about Agent Compute Engine and indicate your interest in Agent Compute Engine.
Help shape Agent Substrate built in the open with the community. Try it on GKE today by visiting its open-source repository.
Learn more about agent governance and indicate your interest.
Come visit us at AGNTCon+MCPCon to speak with experts and see our demos.

articles.title: 王腾：iFlow睡眠精度高于AppleWatch 受限于成本确实不便宜
articles.text:
快科技10月22日消息，今日宜休创始人王腾聊到自家iFlow智能温控系统，坦言这套设备的睡眠监测精度比AppleWatch更高，但硬件元器件成本摆在那里，产品定价不会太低。
iFlow这套系统不用更换床垫，直接加装温控床品就可以使用，还支持双区独立调温，夫妻两个人睡一张床，可以各自设置不一样的温度，怕冷怕热的矛盾直接解决。
整套设备靠TEC半导体加上水循环，完成床面制冷和制热，还能跟着用户不同睡眠阶段，自动调整温度，帮助改善入睡和深睡体验。
它不需要佩戴手表、戒指这类穿戴设备，靠床面自带传感器采集睡眠状态。
王腾表示，相比AppleWatch戴在手腕采集数据，床体无感采集的睡眠数据精度更好。
iFlow核心是赢在产品形态。床体上采用的是持续供电的BCG压阻式传感器，传感器形态先天就会比ppg光电传感器更适合采集睡眠数据。
其次，iFlow的监控是全时序的，AppleWatch是抽样信号。
王腾强调，AppleWatch是穿戴设备里最精准的，但不一定就是所有睡眠监测设备里最精准的。
不过高精度对应的就是硬件成本上涨，王腾也不回避，承认受限于硬件成本，产品确实不会很便宜。但对比海外同类Eight Sleep产品，售价区间在18000元到24999元，iFlow价格会更有性价比一些。
当然它也不是完美的产品。手表的优势在于运动、消息提醒，iFlow只聚焦床上睡眠场景，离开床铺就没法采集身体数据。用户不能指望它替代智能手表全部功能，二者定位不一样。
不少网友很关心最终售价，官方还没有公布确切价格，完整定价会在10月29日发布会对外揭晓。

articles.title: PyTorch Conference North America 2026: Accelerating Open Intelligence Together
articles.text:
PyTorch Conference North America 2026 brought 3,500+ attendees to San Jose on October 20–21 for two days focused on accelerating open intelligence and exploring the impact of PyTorch Foundation projects like PyTorch, vLLM, DeepSpeed, Ray, Helion, and Safetensors.
PyTorch Foundation Executive Director, Mark Collier, set the stage for the entire event to demonstrate how the PyTorch Foundation is building the open source software to train and serve models on any chip, in any cloud, for any agent.
Accelerating Open Intelligence Together
Mark Collier’s opening keynotes connected work across research, models, frameworks, infrastructure, hardware, and production. Day 1 examined how shared advances across those layers help the community move faster together. Day 2 looked ahead to broader hardware participation, workloads moving across more environments, and training and customizing frontier models at greater scale.
Recent milestones across the PyTorch ecosystem highlight how AI itself is joining the learning loop to improve code, kernels, and research workflows. Announcements and updates published during the conference and in the preceding days covered the following work.
Native PyTorch on Google TPUs
TorchTPU is an open source collaboration between Google and Meta that introduces a native and principled PyTorch backend for Google TPUs. It supports eager execution and torch.compile, with validated integrations covering TorchTitan for training, vLLM and SGLang for inference, and Ray for orchestration. Workload migration can require only a device change, while peak performance can require additional changes to shapes, sharding, and operations.
Read Introducing TorchTPU.
TorchNeuron for AWS Trainium
TorchNeuron is an open source native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium (and corresponding Amazon EC2 instances: Trn2 and Trn3), enabling AI researchers and practitioners to experiment and run PyTorch workloads with a single configuration change. With eager execution, torch.compile, and native support for PyTorch APIs (DTensor, torch.distributed) and libraries like TorchTitan, TorchNeuron enables workflows from research experimentation to production deployment. The public beta launch under Apache 2.0 was on October 20th at PyTorch Conference.
Read Introducing TorchNeuron.
Compiler Development for IBM Spyre and AMD GPUs
IBM’s “From KTIR to SpyreCode” explains how torch-spyre translates Inductor’s decisions about work division and tensor placement into executable programs. An open source Dataflow Scheduler builds pipelines for data movement and computation before device-specific stages produce SpyreCode. The October 21 FlyDSL update also described an optional backend for AMD MI350-series GPUs, connecting eligible operations to optimized kernels through existing PyTorch APIs while retaining existing implementations for unsupported workloads.
Read From KTIR to SpyreCode.
TorchTitan and TitanRL
TorchTitan expanded model support across its 5D parallelism stack and introduced reinforcement learning through TitanRL. TitanRL keeps the same model implementation across pretraining, post-training, and execution inside vLLM, with asynchronous rollouts and multiple forms of parallelism for training and generation. The update also covers performance improvements, FlexShard, graph-based training, distributed communication, and checkpointing.
Read the TorchTitan update.
Helion and NVIDIA CompileIQ
Helion’s integration with NVIDIA CompileIQ adds compiler controls to the kernel autotuning search. Developers can evaluate Advanced Control Files alongside kernel configurations such as tile sizes and warp counts, tune offline, and pin the selected configuration. Compiler defaults remain a candidate in the search.
Read about Helion and NVIDIA CompileIQ.
ExecuTorch on Arm Cortex-M CPUs
ExecuTorch now provides a direct path from PyTorch training to on-device inference. The Cortex-M backend enables PyTorch models to run directly on Arm Cortex-M CPUs with Arm CMSIS-NN acceleration. It supports all capability tiers (Scalar, DSP, and MVE/Helium) from a single workflow.
Read Bringing ExecuTorch to Arm Cortex-M CPUs.
Bringing Elastically Deterministic Data Loading to TorchTitan with Zephon
Zephon’s TorchTitan integration preserves identical global batches when training resumes on a different GPU count. In a 1B-parameter model test, training resumed from a 16-GPU checkpoint on 8, 32, and 64 GPUs, and the SHA-256 hash of every global batch matched the original run. Zephon tokenizes, packs, shuffles, and mixes data inside the training job, avoiding a preprocessed copy of the corpus.
Read more about Zephon.
Nine New Members Join PyTorch Foundation
New Platinum members include Nebius, Nscale and Shopify, deepening the PyTorch Foundation’s role as the intelligence layer for open source AI development.
The Foundation welcomes the following new members:
Platinum: Nebius, Nscale, and Shopify Inc.
Silver: LightSeek Foundation and Lablup Inc.
Associate: SKOPOS INDIA FOUNDATION, Siksha ‘O’ Anusandhan, Messiah University, and Valencia College.
AI innovation now happens across all stack layers simultaneously, with research, models, infrastructure, hardware, and production continuously driving each other forward. The PyTorch Foundation serves as the central hub of this interconnected ecosystem, uniting researchers, developers, and companies building open AI.
“Open systems learn faster when more people, projects, and organizations are working together, creating compounding gains,” said Mark Collier, Executive Director of PyTorch Foundation. “Open source ecosystems let breakthroughs travel between organizations instead of staying locked inside one company.”
Nebius has also long supported vLLM with compute for development, testing, and benchmarking, including multi-node work on large models such as DeepSeek R1.
Nscale first came to the PyTorch Foundation’s project ecosystem through Ray, the open source framework for distributed computing and scaling AI workloads. Following Nscale’s planned acquisition of Anyscale, the company behind Ray, Nscale has committed to continuing investment in Ray’s development and its contributor community, building on Ray’s governance under the Foundation since the project joined in October 2025.
“Most infrastructure providers treat the framework and the data center as two separate problems. We treat them as one. PyTorch has remained the base layer of AI because it kept the Pythonic style researchers know, while getting serious about performance. Ray, also part of the PyTorch Foundation, does something different: getting that work to run across thousands of GPUs. With Anyscale, the creators of Ray, set to join Nscale, we’re not just using that ecosystem, we’re building the infrastructure underneath it. Joining the PyTorch Foundation as a Platinum member is us backing that directly, not just benefiting from it,” said Nick Jones, VP of Cloud Native Platform Engineering, Nscale
Shopify’s work featured in Cody Mazza-Anthony’s keynote and an accompanying case study. Using a continual learning loop with PyTorch and vLLM, Shopify compresses production failures into model weights every day, beating frontier-model quality, and cutting serving costs by 96%.
Read the full membership press release.
Read more about Nebius joining PyTorch Foundation.
Read more about Nscale joining PyTorch Foundation.
Read Shopify’s continual learning case study.
Day 0: Training, Workshops, and Co-Located Events
Day 0 programming on October 19 included:
PyTorch, Powering the Enterprise with Red Hat, NVIDIA, and IBM
LF AI & Data Summit 2026
PyTorch Associate Training
Jupyter Day
From Academia to Adoption Workshop
Arm Create with Google, Google DeepMind, Nota, and Renesas
Fine-Tune LLMs on Amazon SageMaker and Run Them On-Device with GenieX
The PyTorch Associate Training offered an in-person, instructor-led program focused on the foundational and practical skills covered by the PyTorch Certified Associate (PTCA) exam. Through lectures, demonstrations, guided labs, and assessments, the training was designed to help participants build and optimize real-world models from scratch. Course completion included a voucher for the certification exam.
Thank you to lead trainer Faradawn Yang, content creator Sahdev Zala, and assistant trainers Allison Ding, Krishna Kalyan, Santosh Bahir, Lakshay Garg, and Ian Wang.
Hosted by the PyTorch Foundation OSPO & Academic Outreach Working Group, the From Academia to Adoption Workshop focused on taking promising PyTorch projects beyond a single paper, experiment, or lab. The community event explored how research software can become reliable, reusable tools that others can adopt, contribute to, and build upon.
Two Days of Keynotes
Tuesday, October 20
Accelerating Open Intelligence Together: Mark Collier (PyTorch Foundation)
Shopify’s Continual Learning Loop with PyTorch and vLLM: Cody Mazza-Anthony (Shopify)
PyTorch Updates: Alban Desmaison and Edward Yang (Meta)
MAX and Mojo: The Best Way to Extend PyTorch: Chris Lattner (Qualcomm)
Ray’s Evolution to Support AI Workloads: Ion Stoica (UC Berkeley / Anyscale)
Trainium’s Journey to Native PyTorch: Robert Hundt (Amazon)
Beyond Brute Force: The Era of Adaptive Intelligence: Sara Hooker (Adaption)

articles.title: 英特尔巨型晶圆厂宣布量产计划：预计应用18A芯片 2028年底前量产
articles.text:
快科技10月22日消息，英特尔周三宣布，其位于亚利桑那州的Fab 62工厂已开始安装生产设备，该工厂有望在2028年底前实现量产。
Fab 62工厂的框架结构建设早已完成，现在该公司正着手安装生产设备。英特尔预计新工厂将于2028年底前投入运营，但尚未透露何时开始大规模量产以及将生产哪些制程节点。
尽管英特尔14A工艺节点曾被讨论为Fab 62工厂的潜在生产基地，但英特尔尚未正式将Fab 62工厂指定为Intel 14A的生产基地。
同时，英特尔最初对Fab 62的规划与其目前的承诺存在重要区别。英特尔在亚利桑那州宣布建设Fab 52和Fab 62工厂时曾表示，这两座工厂将生产其最先进的工艺技术，包括Intel 20A（2纳米级）和18A（1.8纳米级）。
随后，英特尔将Fab 52指定用于Intel 18A的生产，然而Fab 62的用途至今仍未确定。
根据英特尔今年早些时候公布的制造工艺路线图，Fab 62将能够生产采用18A、18A-P和14A工艺节点的芯片。
英特尔目前在相邻的Fab 52生产Intel 18A芯片，而Fab 62则有可能容纳更多Intel 18A芯片产能，或者用于生产该公司的下一代Intel 14A工艺技术。然而，英特尔尚未确认其在该工厂的计划。
该工厂将成为英特尔的Fab 62，这是英特尔位于奥科蒂洛园区的第六个大批量半导体制造厂，该园区几十年来一直是该公司的主要生产基地之一。

articles.title: 达标没！商务部公布我国家庭平均拥有电视、冰箱、洗衣机、手机数量
articles.text:
快科技10月22日消息，商务部今日对外发布最新国内居民消费相关统计数据，截至2025年末，我国家庭平均持有的手机数量达到2.5部。
商务部相关负责人表示，当前我国居民消费的整体导向，正在全面由过去追求量的满足，向追求质的提升快速转变。
统计数据清晰显示，截至2025年末，我国家庭平均拥有的电视数量为1.1台、冰箱为1.1台、洗衣机刚好达到1台，绝大多数家庭的基础家电消费缺口已经被完全填补，过去所有人都在追求的有没有的刚需问题彻底解决之后，消费者的关注点自然全面转向好不好的品质需求。
这种转变首先体现在消费决策逻辑的变化上，当下的消费者选购商品和服务时，最先考量的不再是价格高低，而是整体品质是否达标，普遍秉持既要花得值、更要买得对的消费理念。
另一方面，不同年龄、不同圈层的消费群体，展现出的需求也呈现出明显的多样化、个性化、差异化特征，主打绿色属性、智能属性、健康属性的各类产品消费需求持续快速释放。从日常使用的智能手机、智能穿戴设备，到近期热度暴涨的人形机器人、外骨骼机器人，越来越多过去只出现在概念视频里的前沿智能产品，正在一步步走进普通中国家庭。
官方同步公布的最新产业数据显示，2026年1到9月，国内市场手机总出货量达到1.89亿部，其中5G手机出货量为1.71亿部，占到同期手机总出货量的90.6%，普及程度已经达到相当高的水平。

articles.title: How Companies Are Using NVIDIA DSX to Break the Power Bottleneck
articles.text:
Companies around the world are building on the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform to plan, simulate and run the grid and the AI factory as one system, from the substation to the rack. Their adoption of the platform responds to an acute problem.
Power is now the biggest bottleneck in infrastructure. More than $300 billion in equipment is backlogged, and over 200 gigawatts of projects are waiting in U.S. interconnection queues.
One root cause of the bottleneck is siloed systems. The grid, the facility and the compute inside have long been designed independently from one another, creating the conditions for delays, risk and stranded capacity.
Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements
To help address this, NVIDIA DSX brings these systems together:
NVIDIA DSX Sim and SimReady assets from leading energy manufacturers let engineers simulate the grid, substation and AI factory together, validating generators, switchgear, power systems and cooling before breaking ground.
NVIDIA DSX Flex syncs AI factory demand with grid conditions and onsite generation, turning AI factories from static loads into flexible grid assets.
NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS and DSX Exchange squeeze more compute from every watt and securely share signals across compute, networking, energy, cooling and operations.
GE Vernova is deploying its grid-to-facility and rack power expertise to complement NVIDIA DSX systems, enabling customers to transform power constraints into competitive advantages while maximizing compute and token output, sustainability and grid reliability.
Hitachi Energy’s battery energy storage system has qualified as NVIDIA DSX Ready,  helping customers identify power infrastructure that meets applicable NVIDIA DSX reference architecture design requirements for resilient, reliable and scalable AI factories.
Schneider Electric, together with AVEVA and ETAP, is advancing NVIDIA DSX with validated NVIDIA Vera Rubin power and cooling reference architectures and an NVIDIA Omniverse-powered AI factory digital twin.
Combining AVEVA’s engineering software expertise with NVIDIA SimReady assets, OpenUSD and Omniverse enables connecting simulations, real-time operational data and AI-driven optimization across AVEVA, Schneider Electric and third-party solutions. Together, these capabilities help organizations design, simulate, operate and optimize data centers across their lifecycle, improving energy efficiency and workload performance while accelerating time to token.
Siemens Energy is expanding its collaboration with NVIDIA by developing a reference design for resilient, scalable and grid-aware power infrastructure across power generation, transmission and distribution. This design is aligned with the requirements of the NVIDIA DSX Vera Rubin AI factory design. The company is also exploring usingNVIDIA technologies such as RAPIDS, Metropolis and Isaac Sim for its Noedra digital twin platform, evaluating how the technologies could enhance grid infrastructure monitoring, identify emerging risks and support unplanned outage prevention.
Phaidra integrated DSX Flex, DSX Max-Q and DSX Exchange into its self-learning agents, optimizing cooling and power allocation to maximize tokens per watt, improve grid flexibility and deliver about 10% more compute within the same power envelope.
Emerald AI integrated its Conductor platform into DSX Flex to help utilities tap underused grid capacity, an approach modeled to unlock up to 100 gigawatts on the existing U.S. grid.
Explore the NVIDIA Omniverse DSX Blueprint and the Vera Rubin DSX AI Factory Reference Design. Learn more from NVIDIA and energy leaders who are accelerating power-flexible AI factories to strengthen the grid at GTC Berlin.

articles.title: PHP差点被远程“开门”？OpenAI先发现，官方紧急补墙
articles.text:
智东西
编译 | 黄菲
编辑 | 江宇
智东西10月22日消息，昨日，美国AI公司OpenAI披露，其参与的安全研究工作协助发现了开源编程语言PHP中的两项严重安全漏洞，即攻击者在特定条件下无需身份验证便可在受影响的服务器上执行代码。目前，PHP项目已于10月21日发布安全更新，修复这两项漏洞。
此次漏洞排查由OpenAI发起的开源软件安全项目Patch the Planet提供支持。该项目通过AI模型与安全工程手段，协助软件维护者和安全研究人员发现、验证并修复严重漏洞。
据PHP基金会（The PHP Foundation，支持PHP开发与维护的非营利组织）披露，安全公司Calif于2026年7月30日启动PHP安全审计。
其中，PHP核心维护团队主导漏洞修复与版本发布，OpenAI和网络安全公司Wiz、Cloudflare则提供技术与协调支持，协助相关机构在漏洞公开前完成防护准备。
一、两项漏洞涉及PHP底层机制，最高评分达9.2
根据PHP基金会10月21日发布的公告，此次修复涉及两项严重的远程代码执行漏洞，编号分别为CVE-2026-109618和CVE-2026-109619，二者的CVSS 4.0评分均为9.2。
CVSS 4.0评分是用来衡量网络安全漏洞严重程度的标准，评分范围0.0至10.0分，分数越高，通常代表漏洞越严重。
第一项漏洞CVE-2026-109618与内存耗尽（OOM）引发的内存损坏有关。当请求恰好在特定时机触及PHP的内存限制时，程序可能留下尚未完整初始化的内部数据，后续清理过程又可能将其当作有效数据处理，进而造成内存损坏。
在Apache的mod_php运行环境下，攻击者无需身份验证即可通过请求触发这一问题，研究人员已在默认配置下验证远程代码执行的可能性。
在PHP-FPM环境下，研究人员也通过应用程序代码路径确认了远程代码执行风险。
第二项漏洞CVE-2026-109619涉及过期的全局状态与释放后使用问题。当程序在特定情况下发生致命错误时，内部状态可能仍指向此前请求使用过的内存。
后续由同一工作进程处理的请求可能继续访问这块已经释放的内存，导致工作进程崩溃，研究人员也已在实际应用场景中验证远程代码执行的可能性。
这两项漏洞均涉及PHP底层的内存管理和错误处理机制，几乎每个请求都可能经过相关代码路径。
由于这些机制处于PHP运行流程的核心位置，修复工作不仅要消除安全风险，还要兼顾向后兼容性、运行性能及大量第三方扩展的正常运行。
PHP官方公告提出，所有处理Web请求的PHP安装环境均可能受到影响，包括PHP-FPM、Apache mod_php、php-cgi、FrankenPHP和LiteSpeed等运行方式。
其中，Apache mod_php环境的风险最高，研究人员已证明攻击者可以在应用程序代码运行前触发攻击。
PHP项目已发布PHP 8.5.12、8.4.27、8.3.36和8.2.35四个维护版本，修复上述漏洞。
官方建议用户尽快升级至相应修复版本。对于暂时无法升级的用户，部分临时措施可以降低特定攻击路径的风险，但不能替代完整更新。
二、AI辅助排查揭示漏洞影响，PHP修复工作持续数月
此次安全排查并非始于2026年。PHP基金会披露，2024年，PHP接受了多年未开展的外部安全审计。
该审计由PHP基金会获得资金支持后组织开展，具体工作由安全公司Quarkslab执行。
在修复审计发现的问题时，一名受PHP基金会聘用的PHP核心开发人员首次发现了与内存耗尽有关的异常迹象。
该研究人员当时推测这一问题可能存在可利用的攻击路径，但尚未找到明确的远程代码执行方法。
PHP安全团队随后尝试了多种修复方案，但每种方案都面临不同限制，包括破坏向后兼容性、引入新的拒绝服务风险，或要求大量第三方扩展同步修改。
由于当时尚未发现明确的远程代码执行路径，加之熟悉PHP底层机制的核心开发人员数量有限，修复工作多次停滞、重启。
2026年7月30日，PHP基金会将项目纳入OpenAI的Patch the Planet计划，由Calif开展进一步安全审计。
8月11日，Calif研究人员Ryan A报告了一条可实现远程代码执行的攻击路径，其根因正是PHP团队在2024年发现的内存耗尽问题。
OpenAI也在同一天独立报告了相同根因，并于9月18日提交了其他攻击路径。Wiz于8月24日提交相关发现。
这些报告让PHP团队明确了原有内存问题可能造成的完整影响。
从8月11日起，修复该问题成为PHP基金会安全团队的首要任务。由于漏洞涉及PHP底层机制，修复需要在安全性、兼容性和性能之间进行权衡，PHP基金会安排多名人员持续投入，并与外部研究人员、软件分发方和服务提供商协调。
在此期间，PHP的安全工作机制也发生了变化。PHP基金会于2026年5月成立生态系统安全团队（Ecosystem Security Team），负责协助安全团队开展报告分流、协调和代码加固工作。
基金会还陆续引入人员处理安全报告、漏洞修复及系统加固，并使用OpenAI的Daybreak Red等工具验证报告和漏洞利用方法。
10月20日，两个漏洞的编号开始在网络论坛和社交媒体传播，相关帖子还错误地给出了发布时间和CVSS评分。
PHP项目因此提前发布预告，并将原定于10月22日的安全更新提前至10月21日发布，为软件分发方留出准备更新包的时间。
最终，PHP项目在10月21日发布四个维护版本，修复两项漏洞。
此次事件也促使PHP基金会重新审视安全决策流程，希望让复杂漏洞的修复工作更快获得管理层介入，并减少因决策机制和资源不足造成的延误。
三、AI能加快漏洞发现，但不能替代安全维护人员
OpenAI称，此次事件体现了AI辅助安全研究的潜力。
AI模型能够帮助研究人员发现影响范围广泛的软件漏洞，并在漏洞公开前为维护团队争取修复时间。OpenAI将这一阶段称为“防御者窗口期”（Defender’s Window），即维护者和安全服务商有机会先于攻击者发现问题、开发补丁并准备防护措施。
不过，漏洞发现只是整个安全响应过程的一部分。
PHP基金会披露，自2026年7月1日以来，团队已发布15个CVE编号的漏洞公告，同时处理了100多份最终被判定为无效、重复或无法复现的报告。
随着AI辅助研究增多，安全团队需要投入更多精力筛选报告、复现问题和评估风险。AI可以协助验证报告、归并具有相同根因的问题，但最终判断和补丁开发仍由专业人员负责。
此次PHP漏洞修复所面临的兼容性、性能和第三方扩展适配问题，也难以仅凭模型发现漏洞就自动解决。
这暴露出开源软件安全维护中的现实压力。PHP被广泛用于政府服务、在线商店、银行和媒体网站等场景，但其底层安全工作仍依赖规模有限的核心开发者团队，以及PHP基金会提供的资金和人员支持。
即使AI能够更快发现漏洞，维护团队仍需要足够的工程资源完成修复、测试和版本发布。
为应对这一问题，OpenAI提出了一套面向广泛使用软件的重大漏洞协同响应框架，涵盖漏洞验证与修复、向受影响组织提前通报、协调政府及基础设施服务商、准备更新，以及补丁发布后的部署指导。
OpenAI还称，将通过Patch the Planet等计划提供模型访问权限、安全工程支持和响应协调，帮助更多开源项目应对安全问题。
结语：AI加速漏洞发现，开源安全仍需长期维护
AI辅助研究正在缩短软件漏洞从发现到验证的时间，但发现漏洞并不意味着风险已经消除。
对于PHP等广泛应用的开源基础软件而言，AI可以提高漏洞排查效率，却无法取代专业人员在维护中的作用。
随着AI发现漏洞的能力继续增强，如何为开源维护团队提供足够的工程资源，并建立高效的修复机制，将成为软件安全体系需要面对的重要问题。

articles.title: SB Energy Considers Waiting Until December or Later for an IPO
articles.text:
SB Energy, the SoftBank Group–controlled developer of a massive planned Ohio data center project for OpenAI, is considering going public in December or possibly waiting until next year, according to people familiar with the discussions.
That is a later timeline than previously expected. The data center developer was aiming to go public as soon as September, The Information reported in August. But since then, the public market has soured on initial public offerings from data center and AI cloud companies. articles.title: 陈立武喊话：不能让台积电垄断先进芯片制造 中国追赶速度惊人
articles.text:
快科技10月22日消息，据报道，英特尔CEO陈立武近日在接受媒体专访时，对全球先进芯片制造过度集中于台积电发出了明确警告，并罕见地给出了对中国芯片制造技术差距的判断。
陈立武指出，承担制造环节的晶圆代工企业不应由一两家公司垄断市场，而应更加分散。他明确表示，英特尔、台积电、三星以及日本Rapidus都有必要承担起扩充制造基础的责任。
这番表态的背景是，台积电目前在7纳米以下先进逻辑芯片代工市场的份额已接近九成，在整个晶圆代工市场的占有率也高达约73%。陈立武直言，全球AI芯片95%的产能依赖一家企业，风险极高。
在采访中，陈立武被问及一个备受关注的问题：在美国制裁限制中国获取EUV光刻机的情况下，中国能否在五到十年内追上美国的先进芯片制造水平。
他的回答简短而直接：“就目前来看，我认为并没有落后太多。”陈立武还补充称，中国大陆拥有许多优秀人才，清华大学、北京大学等高校的研发能力不逊于麻省理工和斯坦福。
这一判断背后，折射出中国芯片产业极其惊人的追赶速度。在缺乏最先进EUV光刻机、面临严厉出口管制的极端受限环境下，中国不仅没有被甩开代差，反而通过架构创新和成熟工艺的深度挖掘，不断缩小与前沿水平的距离。
蔡司半导体业务负责人此前曾评估，中国在最新EUV技术上落后约15年。但陈立武的立场更侧重于竞争态势本身，他认为中美企业各有优势与短板，最终决定胜负的是谁能造出最满足客户需求的产品。
在中国大陆一侧，中芯国际的先进制程仍停留在7纳米级别。但华为等芯片设计企业正通过逻辑折叠技术，在DUV工艺条件下持续挖掘性能潜力，试图以架构创新弥补制程差距。

articles.title: 蚂蚁版Jev模型来了！27B版本综合评分第一，Token省90%
articles.text:
智东西
作者 | 杨京丽
编辑 | 李水青
智东西10月22日报道，今日，蚂蚁数科发布决策模型LingDT-Decision-1.0。该模型提供4B和27B两个版本，专为客服、风控、金融等产业AI场景中的高频决策任务打造，首创推出原生多选与按序决策（DAG）功能。
目前，该模型已上线蚂蚁数科DTMaaS平台，开发者可限时免费体验。
决策模型不生成长篇文本，直接返回选项、分数或判断结果，可用于意图识别、工单路由、工具选择、模型路由和风险判断等。这类模型近期因Jev走红而受到持续关注。继Jev之后，微软、Perplexity等厂商也相继推出了自己的决策模型。
LingDT-Decision-1.0与Jev都面向结构化决策，但侧重点有所不同。Jev更为通用，主要面向开发者和软件系统中的通用决策层，常用于路由请求、选择工具、安排Agent流程或触发人工审核；LingDT-Decision-1.0则更专用，主要面向客服、风控和金融等企业业务中的复合决策与多步骤流程。
在模型能力上，Jev主要通过预设选项完成选择、评分或真假判断。其中，Choice通常返回一个最高概率选项，也可以通过并行提出多个问题实现多项判断。LingDT-Decision-1.0则能够同时识别多个诉求，并按照任务之间的依赖关系，调整处理顺序。
蚂蚁数科团队的测试显示，在数据标注等场景中处理同样任务时，LingDT-Decision-1.0相比DeepSeek-V4-flash，可将Token消耗降低97%，响应时效提升约10倍，同时保持更优的性能表现。
在23项开源评测基准中，LingDT-Decision-1.0的综合评分超过了Microsoft-Decision-1、Jev 1.13.0等热门决策模型，27B版本在同参数模型中取得最高准确率。
一、Token消耗降低超90%，覆盖客服、风控等高频任务
企业业务中存在大量不需要生成完整答案、但需要快速完成判断的任务。
例如，在客服场景中，用户称“这个订单已经三天没有发货，请尽快处理”，AI需要判断这是催单、退款还是投诉，判断工单紧急程度，选择归属部门，并识别是否需要人工接管。
传统大语言模型通常需要先生成结构化答案，再由后续程序进行解析和校验。LingDT-Decision-1.0则可以在限定选项中直接完成判断，减少输出格式不稳定带来的影响。
蚂蚁数科公布的测试数据显示，在数据标注场景中，LingDT-Decision-1.0相比DeepSeek-V4-flash，其Token消耗降低约97%，处理时效提升约10倍；在智能客服场景中，相比Qwen-3.7-flash，其Token消耗降低90%，处理时效提升约1倍，风险识别准确率由76%提升至89%。
在金融应用场景中，LingDT-Decision-1.0可用于意图识别、工具调用和幻觉检测。测试显示，相关任务处理时效提升约5倍，工具组合完全匹配率提升约2.6倍，幻觉召回率由44%提升至70%。
测试结果显示，LingDT-Decision-1.0在客服、风控和金融等场景中均表现出低Token消耗、低延迟和较高准确率。同一模型还可以覆盖多类决策任务，便于企业在不同业务流程中复用。
二、支持原生多选与按序决策，27B版本综合评分第一
蚂蚁数科称，LingDT-Decision-1.0除了支持判断、单选、分类和评级等基础能力外，还首创推出原生多选与按序决策能力，适配企业业务中复杂、多步骤的决策需求。
原生多选能力可以让模型在一项任务中同时命中多个候选选项，适用于多标签识别、复合意图和工具组合。例如，用户提出“我要退款、关闭续费、补开发票，但不要注销账号”，模型可以同时识别退款、关闭续费和补开发票等多个诉求。
按序决策则可以根据任务之间的依赖关系完成多步判断。例如，退款需要先核验，关闭续费可以立即执行，发票处理可能需要等待退款结果。相比只返回一个选项的单项决策，这种方式更贴近企业业务中的真实处理流程。
在23项主流开源评测基准中，LingDT-Decision-1.0的27B版本综合评分位居第一。该评分由90%的单选成绩和10%的多选成绩构成。蚂蚁数科称，LingDT-Decision-1.0的准确率超过Microsoft-Decision-1、Jev 1.13.0和Fastino/GLiDE等决策模型。
其中，在多选任务上，4B和27B版本的准确率超过Microsoft-Decision-1、Jev 1.13.0、Star-lux等16个决策模型；在单选任务上，两个版本模型也处于第一梯队。
结语：决策模型加速进入产业AI
决策模型为意图识别、任务分类、工具选择和风险判断等高频任务提供了新的解决方案。由于不需要生成长篇文本，它可以直接返回结构化结果，从而降低Token成本，提升响应速度。
此次蚂蚁数科发布LingDT-Decision-1.0，则将决策模型进一步放到客服、风控和金融等企业业务流程中进行验证。原生多选和按序决策能力，也让模型能够处理复合意图和多步骤任务。随着更多决策模型进入实际业务，其性能表现和适用边界也将得到进一步检验。

articles.title: TSMC is seeking chipmaking equipment that doesn't contain Chinese rare-earth magnets
articles.text:
TSMC, the world's largest contract chip manufacturer, is seeking alternative machinery without rare-earth components to reduce its dependence on China-dominated materials and avoid disruptions to factory operations caused by the country's export controls. According to a Reuters report on October 22 citing people familiar with the matter, the Taiwanese company has begun approaching its equipment suppliers to explore whether they can provide factory automation equipment equipped with motors that don't require rare-earth materials.
Go deeper with TH Premium: Chipmaking
(Image credit: tsmc)
Analyzing TSMC's fab expansion roadmap — multi-fab N2 ramp, CoWoS, SoIC, and uncorking bottlenecks
Leading-edge foundry roadmaps for TSMC, Intel, and Samsung
ASML's roadmap for chipmaking lithography tools examined
Chinese chipmaking tool roadmaps examined
TSMC supplies the extremely powerful Nvidia chips that are facilitating the AI boom. It also manufactures chips for Apple, Broadcom, Qualcomm, and numerous other tech and automotive companies. The company operates enormous, highly automated semiconductor fabrication plants. These factories use industrial machinery that relies on electric motors with powerful permanent magnets made from rare-earth elements such as neodymium, dysprosium, and terbium.
According to the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS), China accounts for roughly 70% of global rare earth mining. The International Energy Agency (IEA) says China also controls around 90% of refining and approximately 95% of the finished permanent magnets found in TSMC’s machines, giving Beijing a quasi-absolute monopoly over one of the most critical technology supply chains. In April 2025, the country placed seven medium and heavy rare earths and the magnets made from them under export controls, requiring exporters to seek case-by-case approval and export licenses, thereby choking shipments to manufacturers across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, including TSMC.
China expanded the controls on October 9, 2025, to include five additional rare earths, processing technology and equipment, and even products manufactured outside the country that contain more than 0.1% Chinese-origin rare earths, or are made using Chinese processing technology. It later suspended the October expansion for one year, until November 10, 2026. This has now been extended for an additional 90 days.
TSMC’s moves aim to reduce the risk that these controls will hinder production at its factories. Even with all other raw materials and machinery required to manufacture its chips, shortages of specialized motor components could complicate the maintenance, repair, or expansion of its production equipment. Several technological approaches allow motors to avoid rare earth magnets. Conventional induction motors, for example, generate torque using electromagnetic induction rather than permanent magnets. Switched-reluctance motors are another option, while some permanent-magnet motors can use ferrite magnets instead of rare-earth magnets. However, these technologies typically involve different trade-offs in efficiency, size, power density, precision, and control requirements.
Meanwhile, the rest of the world is undertaking the painstaking, drawn-out task of building a rare-earth supply chain outside China. Taiwan is reportedly pursuing domestic rare-earth production capabilities in collaboration with the United States, with both countries confirming their intent to reduce reliance on Chinese rare-earth and critical-mineral supply chains.
Taiwan's government is supporting the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) in establishing a pilot production line within three years that could supply about 50% of Taiwan's domestic rare-earth demand. Meanwhile, the U.S. is “working with Taiwan and other partners to develop alternative sources of supply, expand processing capacity and build more resilient supply chains,” according to the report. In February 2026, the Trump administration announced plans to create a $12 billion critical minerals stockpile to offset supply chain risks from China.

articles.title: 百度世界2026前瞻：10+重磅分论坛，全面解码AI时代的智能组织进化路径
articles.text:
企业AI转型正在走向深水区，从单点工具和业务场景提效，向系统性的组织重构延伸。麦肯锡曾在《组织状态报告2026》中指出，尽管AI被视为新一轮生产力革命的重要驱动力，但真正将其转化为经营业绩的企业仍是少数，背后的关键在于，不少企业仍将AI转型停留在“工具升级”层面，却忽视了更本质的“组织重构”。如何将AI能力融入组织，转化为持续的生产力，将成为影响企业未来竞争力的关键。11月12日，百度将在百度世界2026大会上聚焦“智能组织”议题，或将提出AI时代的组织进化范式。
10月21日，百度官方公众号发文披露了百度世界2026分论坛的更多议程信息。本届大会设置10+场分论坛，围绕“AI驱动组织跃迁”、“AI办公与知识工作”、“技术、行业与生态”三大方向展开，涵盖组织进化、智能体规模化落地、AI办公、AI+自进化、垂直产业增长、超级个体能力进阶等议题，为企业和开发者推进智能组织建设提供多维度的实践参考。
看点一：覆盖AI组织重构全链条，揭秘“智能组织”进化方法论
AI时代，组织形态或将朝着以人和智能体编队协同的方向演进，这一转变涉及人机协同机制、工作流重构、组织文化变革与安全治理等多个环节。本届大会分论坛议题将覆盖组织自上而下进行AI重构的全链条，解码企业如何将AI内化为组织能力，构筑竞争优势。
「组织进化：AI驱动组织跃迁」分论坛上，百度将分享内部智能组织建设的实践与最新成果，进一步呈现“内化AI能力”如何落实到企业运行之中。据悉，该论坛将围绕岗位边界重构、“组织looping”飞轮、AI资产沉淀及智能体安全、打开人才上限等议题，剖析组织如何在持续迭代中实现自我进化，激发组织活力。
「Agent扎根研发生产：如何从“用AI”到“成为AI企业”」分论坛将围绕智能体底座、数据与知识、场景选择、组织与人才四个方面，梳理企业从单点应用AI走向体系化转型的关键条件，分享AI原生企业构建案例。
看点二：从超级个体到超级组织，解码AI从个人提效走向组织增智
随着智能体、数字人等AI应用加速融入企业生产经营场景，AI的价值释放逐渐从个人提效转向依托团队协作、组织增效。本届大会分论坛还将展示百度在智能体领域的最新布局，分享智能体、数字人等在高价值知识工作场景中的产品与案例，为企业和开发者从具体场景入手、推动个人提效向组织增智延伸提供实践思路。
「搭子进行时·北京站 — 智能体如何从办公桌走向生产线」分论坛将围绕通用智能体演进趋势、企业级应用、生态共建等议题，结合百度搭子融入个人办公、团队协作和企业业务的实践，分享以智能体赋能超级个体、提升组织生产力的方法论，进一步推动产业智能。
「超级智能 全球上岗 — 成就超级个体 打造超级组织」分论坛将从用户、团队协作与全球化应用三个视角，聚焦超级个人与超级组织的进化路径、企业Agent对组织协作的重构，以及AI办公全球化发展新机遇等议题，讨论AI如何从个人效率工具走向组织级生产力。
数字人分论坛将聚焦数字人Agent的全新升级，探讨数字人Agent在品牌营销、跨境出海、售后服务、企业内训等多个业务场景应用，呈现数字人如何从虚拟形象升级为智能组织中可被调度、可复用、持续创造价值的生产力。
看点三：从组织实践到行业方案，展现智能组织在千行百业的落地路径
智能组织的落地，还需要与不同行业的业务需求和场景特点紧密结合。本届大会分论坛中，百度还将联合合作伙伴，围绕具身智能、品牌营销、游戏等领域，交流AI融入业务流程与组织协作的实践经验，为形成可供行业借鉴的解决方案提供思路，助力千行百业向智能组织演进。
「具身智能如何从场景验证走向商业落地」分论坛将围绕世界模型、多模态具身认知、物理推理、具身大脑、行为理解及仿真交互等议题，探讨提升具身智能对真实环境的理解与任务执行能力的技术路径，推动其从场景验证走向可迭代、可规模化的产业应用。
「如何用AI实现营销全周期闭环：洞察·创意·优化」分论坛将聚焦内容生产、组织协作与科学投放三大环节，聚焦数字人让广告内容生产提效10倍、AI数字员工推动营销经验在组织内复用、科学算法将以往“凭经验拍板”的预算分配转化为确定性增长等实践，呈现AI融入营销全链路的解决方案。
「从提效到AI原生，如何找到游戏产业增长新曲线」分论坛将联合国内前沿AI游戏团队，围绕游戏开发、AI NPC及智能安全等议题，探讨大模型和Agent重塑游戏开发流程，融入角色交互与玩法设计的实践，推动AI从辅助游戏开发走向AI原生游戏创造，拓展“千人千面”的游戏体验。
看点四：探讨AI前沿技术趋势，助力科学发现进程
AI技术的进化速度，深刻影响着产业落地的广度与深度。当前，智能体等技术正加速向自我进化方向演进，RSI成为行业热议话题。本届大会还将聚焦RSI、AI4S等前沿议题，探讨AI技术变革趋势及其在产业场景中的应用前景。
「RSI如何重塑科学工程研发」分论坛将分享智能体自我进化的前沿趋势，聚焦RSI在材料研发、芯片设计、量子计算与可控核聚变等领域的应用探索，讨论自我改进系统在解决复杂科学与工程问题中的应用价值与能力边界。
「AI4S如何加速科学研究与生命健康创新跃迁」分论坛将聚焦AI for Science与AI for Healthcare，解析算力、云、大模型及智能体等技术在科学研究与生命健康领域的应用，呈现AI在助力科研方法创新、生命科学复杂问题求解及新药全流程研发中的作用。
据悉，除10+场分论坛外，本届大会还设置1场主论坛、30余场AI公开课及6000平米AI展区。百度创始人李彦宏将在大会开幕式上发表主题演讲，分享对智能组织演进趋势的思考。此外，百度还将发布“芯云模体”全栈AI最新进展，为企业和开发者推进智能组织建设提供技术与产品支持。
百度世界2026已开放报名，提供VIP票、优享票、全通票及免费票四种票型，可通过大会官网（https://baiduworld2026.events.net.cn/tickets）或大会小程序报名参会。

articles.title: 涨价还没到头！500亿存储龙头涨停：DRAM合约价四季度再涨20%
articles.text:
快科技10月22日消息，存储芯片涨价周期仍在延续，资本市场率先给出反应。存储封测龙头华天科技今日午后直线封死涨停。
这轮行情的核心催化剂来自价格端。据集邦咨询最新数据，2026年第四季度DRAM合约价格预计环比再涨约20%。从涨幅节奏看，二季度约80%、三季度约40%，四季度20%的增速虽在放缓，但DRAM市场整体仍处于供应紧张、需求强劲的周期高位，涨价远未到头。
推动价格持续上行的底层动力，是AI推理对存储带宽和容量的结构性吞噬。大模型推理需要频繁读取KV缓存与模型权重，单台AI服务器对HBM和服务器DRAM的搭载量是传统服务器的数倍。
此外，三星、SK海力士、美光等原厂将先进制程产能优先分配给HBM和服务器DDR5，通用DRAM的供给被持续挤压，供需缺口短期内难以弥合。
在这一轮涨价链条中，封测环节的技术门槛正在被重新定价。华天科技并非简单的“代工封装”，其已掌握DDR5 DRAM封装技术并实现量产，同时具备FC、TSV、Fan-Out、2.5D及3D等先进封装能力。
需要指出的是，TSV硅通孔和3D堆叠是HBM制造的核心工艺，随着DRAM从平面走向三维，封测环节从产业链末端的技术执行者，升级为决定芯片带宽、功耗和良率的关键变量。这也是存储封测龙头能在涨价周期中率先获得资金重估的技术逻辑。
封测环节的技术升级给了市场底气，而芯片价格本身的走势则直接点燃了情绪。韩国央行行长申铉松今日表态，为行业景气度提供了官方注脚。他表示，相对于芯片制造商的股价，更应关注芯片价格本身，当前芯片价格没有下跌迹象，可能进一步上涨。

articles.title: Intergroup Bias Predicts Expressions of Social Judgment and Empathy in the r/AmITheAsshole Reddit Community
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.29254v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: People share and understand others' experiences differently based on their social identities; often, people empathize more when the other person belongs to their ingroup compared to an outgroup. While this intergroup empathy gap is well-studied in social psychology, it remains unclear how it manifests in naturally occurring online social interactions. To this end, we measure how commenters express social judgments, as an indirect outcome of their understanding towards the posters, and empathy in text, based on whether commenters share the poster's gender or are of similar ages. We focus on posts where the poster self-reports these demographics, and analyze 126,716 comments associated with 36,163 posts from 18,111 commenters in r/AmItheAsshole, while controlling for commenter and poster group identities, post features (topic, length, and score), and both commenter- and post-level variance. Our results show that when commenters and posters are ingroup, in either gender or age, commenters are more likely to provide a Not the Asshole verdict and show greater text-based understanding as measured by LLMs. We also observe that older commenters behave differently from younger ones. Furthermore, in a subset of posts where the gender and age of the other party in the conflict are explicitly mentioned, we find that commenter-poster ingroup effects are moderated by the group relationships between the poster and the other party when commenters make social judgments. Our work highlights the importance of intergroup context and social group nuances in understanding online discourse.

articles.title: 苹果首款折叠屏手机！iPhone Duo开售：15999元起 史上最贵
articles.text:
快科技10月23日消息，今日，苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo正式开售，国行起售价为15999元，这也是苹果史上最贵iPhone。
苹果中国官网显示，每位顾客限购2部iPhone Duo。
作为苹果首款折叠屏手机，iPhone Duo采用书本式折叠设计，配备7.6英寸可折叠内屏和5.4英寸外屏，均采用超视网膜XDR显示屏，并支持ProMotion自适应刷新率技术。

续航方面，苹果官方数据显示，iPhone Duo使用外屏播放视频最长可达44小时，使用内屏播放视频最长可达31小时。
值得注意的是，iPhone Duo没有实体SIM卡槽，仅支持eSIM，中国大陆用户可通过中国移动、中国电信和中国联通办理相关业务。
随着iPhone Duo上市开售，也意味着苹果正式进入折叠屏手机市场。
作为苹果在产品形态上的一次重要尝试，新机能否凭借软硬件协同和品牌影响力，在竞争激烈的折叠屏市场站稳脚跟，值得关注。

articles.title: 全国产芯片训练的大模型来了！百万上下文，价格比DeepSeek V4.1 Flash更低
articles.text:
智东西
作者 | 程茜
编辑 | 心缘
智东西10月22日报道，今日，科大讯飞发布数个大模型及AI应用新成果，包括端云一体大模型讯飞星火X2.6、语音基座模型SparkAudio 1.0、星火具身多模态交互技术、WinWork数字员工平台、超级AI教师助手讯飞星光等。
其端云一体讯飞星火X2.6基座模型基于全国产算力完成能力升级，包含云端的293-A30B模型及端侧的X2.6-4B模型，后一模型已开源。
云端模型293-A30B支持百万token上下文，输入价格为0.9元/百万tokens，输入缓存命中价格为0.08元/百万tokens，输出价格为3.6元/百万tokens。输入缓存未命中、输出价格比DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017更低。
根据科大讯飞公布的测试结果，星火X2.6-4B模型在信息搜索问答、办公文档处理、日程任务管理、本地表格操作、跨工具协同、多轮工具调用、复杂知识搜索上均超越了其上一代Spark-X2.5-4B以及Qwen3.5-4B、Gemma4-E4B、Qwen3.5-9B模型。
此外科大讯飞还官宣了数个AI硬件，如讯飞AI录音环、讯飞AI眼镜、讯飞AI PC系列等产品。其中灵机N9000 AIPC笔记本最高具备160 TOPS本地AI算力；星火办公一体机提供2240 TOPS AI算力，支持大模型私有化部署。
目前，科大讯飞的产品矩阵已经以讯飞星火基座大模型为底座，在教育、医疗、教育、法律、汽车、机器人等领域实现应用。
科大讯飞创始人、董事长刘庆峰称，今天的AI正成为人类历史上有史以来最具颠覆性的技术革命和产业革命，没有之一。
他认为，全栈自主可控大模型是AI安全性和极致性价比的必然选择，这就需要全栈自主可控的端云一体大模型来解决。未来会有60%的任务在本地跑，30%的任务通过云端协同处理，10%的任务在云端独立处理，这也是科大讯飞此次推出端云一体大模型X2.6的关键原因。
一、基于全国产算力训练，首发端云一体大模型
在科大讯飞公开的基准测试结果中，代码能力方面，星火X2.6在SWE Pro、SWE Multilingual两项测试集中拿下第一，SWE Verified测试集中仅次于DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 1017；智能体赛道上，其在企业运维类Agent和通用工具调用MCP-Atlas中，都处于第一梯队；在推理能力方面，星火X2.6在AA-LCR v1.1测试集中与MiniMax M3持平。
在训练侧，该模型突破了国产芯片长程任务训练瓶颈，以国产超大规模智算平台飞星二号万卡训练2000B 256K长度数据时间为例，训练时间由4.5个月缩短至1.2个月，超长上下文训练效率提升至原来的4倍。刘庆峰称，星火X2.6就是在过去2-3个月训练出来的。
推理层面，科大讯飞基于国产异构算力的分布式推理技术、首个全国产硬件的四层KV Cache架构，攻克了长上下文场景下容量不足、推理时延高、缓存命中率低等难题，飞星二号国产芯片推理效率达到优化前的4.5倍，KV Cache命中率由63%提升至95.7%。
在端侧模型方面，科大讯飞打造了星火X2.6-4B模型。刘庆峰称，这是因为4B大小是非常适合在机器人、汽车平台、AI PC上部署使用的。其上一代星火X2.5-4B端侧模型从9月1日开源至今，下载量达到256万次，位列全球端侧模型前四。
为提升端侧模型能力，科大讯飞采用了端云一体训练技术。星火采用端侧模型能力感知的自适应迭代后训练算法，根据端侧能力动态选择教师模型、调整训练比重。
基于端侧模型精准路由的“云+端”协同架构，先由端侧模型判断任务交给哪种方式完成：纯端办、纯云办、还是由端云协办。这之中的一个关键问题就是端云路由是否准确，科大讯飞引入基于评语模型的端云路由协同训练机制，将端云路由准确率由81.2%提升至96.1%。
在端云一体的星火X2.6模型之上，科大讯飞推出了两款产品：星火Loomy面向日常办公，帮助用户写报告、做PPT、分析数据，让日常工作轻松完成；星火AStudio面向专业办公，帮助用户写代码、搞研究，让复杂工作自主推进。
现场演示人员扮演一个创业公司的总经理，让星火AStudio可以在不联网的情况下，帮用户查看最近各大区的周报、邮件，然后分析经营情况并进行整理。模型在检索内容后，会生成可视化表格、三项待办事项、风险等，还会提供相应的对应邮件链接。
在和云端模型协作的任务中，模型会先对本地数据进行梳理，有需要云端协作任务时，再发起协作申请。在这之前，本地模型会对数据进行脱敏处理。云端处理完后，本地模型会将之前的脱敏信息在此处理，生成完整的内容。
二、语音基座大模型能分析复杂音频，讯飞AI录音环一点就能随时录音、整理
在让AI从数字世界进入物理世界方面，科大讯飞发布了星火语音基座大模型SparkAudio 1.0以及新款AI硬件讯飞AI录音环等。
星火语音基座大模型SparkAudio 1.0，基于全国产算力训练。现场SparkAudio 1.0分析出了一段复杂音频中的背景音乐、男性声音、机械运转声、自行车铃声等诸多声音。
这一模型背后有三项技术创新，分别为半监督音频编码器带来20%的效果提升，动态分段端到端建模使响应时间降低15%，双范式协同解码使成本降低60%。
该模型已经在讯飞输入法16.0、讯飞听见、讯飞智能办公本、讯飞翻译机等产品中上线。其中，讯飞智能办公本升级后，支持手写标注说话人姓名，后续发言自动对应；抢话、多人交叠发言时也能区分说话人；识别中英混合、专业术语。
科大讯飞还发布了一款新的AI硬件讯飞AI录音环，重量为35g，贴合手机磁吸设计。用户只需点击录音环上的录音按钮，就是随时随地记录。录音结束后，其会通过WiFi 6高速传输，2小时录音约10秒传至手机、2分钟转成文字，还能智能区分说话人、生成AI会议纪要、提炼重点及待办事项，并支持多语种同声转译。
该设备目前已在电商平台开售，售价1299元。
在多模态交互方面，科大讯飞主要提升了座舱、眼镜等智能终端理解需求的能力。
讯飞AI眼镜具备显示能力，重量为40g，支持90dB展会噪声抑制，8米远距拾音。这一设备能翻译120+语种，可以连接PC与云端智能体，支持远程指挥电脑端办公工作。该设备售价为4299元起。
讯飞星火智慧座舱SparkAuto Space 3.0的多人交互响应率、多么题啊交互正确率、车外远场交互距离、复杂智能体任务成功率等都大幅提升。
机器人的具身多模态交互会面临开放空间机器人移动降噪识别、多人交互声源及视觉时空对齐、多模态交互及动作联动协同等难题。
基于此，科大讯飞发布了机器人超脑平台V3.0，能实现复杂空间的动态降噪、多目标人的交互意图识别、语音与动作统一的规划与执行、视觉触发的主动交互。
在“7×24小时”AI无人超市场景中，机器人可以结合语音、视觉与位置信息，识别不同顾客的需求，在多人插话或者用户需求反复变化时，也能完成取货、递送与扫码结账等任务。
机器人超脑平台V3.0将向开发者开放，包括星火超脑板、多模态交互模组、具身智能开发套件及具身多模交互Harness。
在为组织提效方面，AI要完成从个人提效到组织提效的跨越，核心在于读懂业务、嵌入业务流程，实现人、数字员工协同作业。
基于此，讯飞推出讯飞星帆WinWork平台。该平台可以通过搭建企业业务本体的方式，沉淀企业的业务规程、业务数据与专家知识库，让数字员工更理解业务；WinWork还能嵌入企业业务流程，支撑数字员工参与完整工作闭环，从自主识别任务、拆解规划、智能分发，到联动各类业务系统执行。
此外，科大讯飞还推出了基于星火端云大模型、国产操作系统的讯飞AI PC系列产品。其中灵机N9000 AIPC笔记本最高具备160 TOPS本地AI算力；星火办公一体机提供2240 TOPS AI算力，支持大模型私有化部署。
三、给老师、学生、律师、医生、患者都配上AI助手
在教育领域，讯飞发布了一款面向老师的超级AI助手讯飞星光。
讯飞星光将备课、教研、家校沟通和事务助理整合到同一工作台，支持教案、动画、情景视频创编、多角色模拟圆桌研讨、规范填报、统计分析与可视化呈现，对内打通智学网，校信等内部通道，对外打通企业微信、QQ、飞书、钉钉等多平台远控通道。
▲帮老师填写家校沟通表
在备课场景中，为了让学生理解电流方向与磁极方向的关系，老师向讯飞星光提出需求，系统生成可旋转观察的三维交互资源，还可结合摄像头手势操作，让学生模拟右手螺旋定则。
▲可旋转观察的三维交互资源
针对学生，科大讯飞AI学习机上线了“探究学”功能。例如蚂蚁爬行最短路径问题，可以通过三维立体观察，展开长方体表面比较不同路线，让孩子先思考、再动手、最后验证。
在医疗领域，讯飞影像云是全球性医学影像AI服务平台，覆盖了全国超过2.6亿人口的区域。医学影像云平台支持影像共享、智能辅诊、质控与报告生成；讯飞晓医是居民身边的AI健康助手，已累计完成AI咨询超过2.2亿次，下载量突破4400万。
在法律领域，科大讯飞推出一站式AI超级法律助手讯飞晓法，覆盖案情梳理、证据审查、诉讼策略、庭审策略和文书起草等任务。
结语：AI落地需精细化调度模型，端云协同是大势所趋
从科大讯飞本次的新模型与系列新品集中发布可以看出，其正基于讯飞星火基座模型，逐步为企业和个人，打造一套直接可交付的商业化AI方案。
其这次首发的端云一体大模型X2.6，核心是对AI任务需求做精细化拆分调度，以此平衡性能、成本、数据安全三者的矛盾，给开发者与企业提供新的落地选择。尤其对教育、医疗、法律这类对数据出境非常敏感的行业来说，这套架构可以契合其私有化、本地部署的需求。
此外，如今大模型行业的竞争，正持续向算力适配、场景落地、数据安全、软硬一体交付等方向延伸，未来只有模型能力、缺少行业闭环与硬件载体的纯底座玩家或被淘汰。

articles.title: Language Impairment as a Lens onto Large Language Models
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.28992v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) encode language in highly distributed spaces, they remain vulnerable to focal disruptions---a phenomenon strikingly similar to how localized brain damage causes clinical aphasia in humans. To investigate this theoretical tension, we ask whether LLMs possess a functional structure analogous to the human language system, by introducing a novel mechanistic interpretability framework inspired by aphasia. Through two complementary approaches, classifier-guided lesioning and continuous activation steering, we systematically induce aphasia-like breakdowns in LLMs. We find that language functions can be successfully isolated to discrete structural circuits and continuous representational vectors, yet these functions remain densely entangled with significant circuit overlap and vector similarities across distinct aphasic profiles. Furthermore, while steering generalizes robustly across downstream tasks, structural lesioning remains asymmetrically constrained. By bridging neuropsychology and mechanistic interpretability, we demonstrate that LLMs, functionally analogous to biological brains, rely on a densely entangled architecture that can be systematically mapped through clinically-informed interventions.

articles.title: Seeing the Forest for the Trees: Emergent Agreement from Individual Conversations
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.29328v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: As LLM agents interact in the wild and shape each other's decisions, understanding how they converge toward agreement becomes important. We study this in multi-turn conversations where two LLMs discuss subjective matters, can agree or disagree, and may change their stances. Using a linear classifier on individual conversation activations, we identify an internal representation of agreement. We find that it varies substantially across turns and conversations and does not reliably track external agreement at the individual conversation level. We therefore move beyond the representation of agreement in individual conversations, by aggregating the agreement representation across conversations. Externally, this aggregate view reveals a simple structure: when pooled across conversations, agreement can be predicted well with a Markov process, with agreement at each turn being a direct function of agreement at the previous turn. Similarly, when internal agreement is aggregated, it couples with the external Markov agreement through a power-law mapping, exposing Markovian dynamics in internal representations. Additionally, we find that after a change of stance, models express agreement externally before their internal representations reflect the same shift. These results reveal a joint structure between internal and external agreement that emerges only when internal features are aggregated across conversations. Code available at https://github.com/technion-cs-nlp/SeeingTheForestForTheTrees.

articles.title: 宇树 10 周年，王兴兴：我劝你相信 AI
articles.text:
10 月 22 日，杭州国际博览中心热闹非常，不仅人多，而且机器人也特别多。
这是 2026 年宇树科技举办的世界物理 AI 大会的现场，从四足机器人到人形机器人，你甚至可以说这里是全球「机器人密度」最高的地方。
2026 年，也是宇树科技创立的第十年。有意思的是，在今天的舞台上，宇树科技创始人王兴兴，在谈机器人之外，聊的最多的就是当下最火热的 AI。
他不仅劝所有人要「相信 AI」，而且还反思，觉得自己「相信 AI 还相信得不够」。
为什么这家中国、乃至全球机器人行业中最有实力的公司掌舵者，会这么说？物理 AI 的拐点，真的要到来了吗？
必须相信 AI
在王兴兴 36 分钟的演讲中，宇树自己的产品只占了开头和结尾。中间最长的一段，王兴兴在做一件事——劝人相信 AI。
从 AI 攻下了一批顶尖数学难题，「人类最智慧的金字塔的尖端」已经被击穿；到 AI 逆向工程让「传统软件公司的壁垒没了」；AI 视频里人物的表情和情绪「比真人演的还好很多」；顶尖大模型公司内部「已经实现了模型的自进化」。
「这不是闹着玩的」。他的结论是，以当下的模型能力，哪怕不再进步，信息世界也已经被「完全击穿」。
然后他说了一句不太像上市公司董事长会说的话，「我感觉我自己还不够相信，还不够坚定」。
这不是即兴发挥。十天前的上海工博会上，他已经当众「认错」过一次，「过去十几年我犯的最大的错误，就是对 AI 的相信还不太够」。他还给过一个倍数，5 年前或 10 年前你喜欢、相信 AI 的程度，「现在乘 10 倍都不为过」。
王兴兴在会上探讨物理 AI 的未来｜图片来源：宇树科技
更直观的变化在时间表上。今年 8 月的世界机器人大会，王兴兴对具身智能「ChatGPT 时刻」的预期还是快则 2 到 3 年、慢则 5 到 10 年；两个月后，这个窗口被他压缩成「1 到 2 年，慢的话 2 到 3 年」。至于随便把一台宇树机器人带进陌生的家里，一句话让它把房间收拾好，「快的话可能明年就可以实现」。工博会上他说得更直白，「明年 GPT-7 出来，可能直接把具身智能问题打穿」。
一个硬件出身的工程师，在两个月里成了全场最激进的 AI 布道者。这看上去像一次认知突变，但把宇树最近半年的处境摊开来看，他的「相信」几乎是一道必答题。
但是，宇树的强项——机器人本体，依然是王兴兴骄傲的事情。
王兴兴在台上最骄傲的是 G1。这款 2024 年 5 月发布的人形机器人，累计下线大约 1 到 2 万台，他称之为全球单一型号出货量最大的人形机器人。
10 月 21 日，宇树放出 H2-X「功夫传奇 守护」的视频，一脚踢瘪车门、徒手抬车、4 米高台空翻落地，续航从 H2 的约 3 小时拉到约 8 小时。可以看到，宇树团队依然在快速迭代公司的产品。
本体之外，一直在布道 AI 的王兴兴，推销的 AI，并不完全是宇树自己的 AI。
随后的论坛环节王兴兴和姚明等嘉宾一同探讨物理 AI 的未来｜图片来源：宇树科技
他在台上很坦白，「我们毕竟是一家新公司」，跟全球最头部的多模态大模型公司「做一模一样的模型，那是不太现实的」。宇树会自研，也会和国内外大模型公司合作。他展示的最亮眼的 demo，是把 GPT-6 接到机器人上，零训练就能自己洗笔、换颜料，在围棋盘上精准落子。他判断规划和导航这类问题「某种意义上已经解决掉了」，剩下的是多模态大模型的输入输出和真实机器人之间的对齐——传感器的误差、执行器的误差，「我觉得这个也是很快可以解决的问题」。
把这几句话连起来，就能看清这份「信仰」背后的商业逻辑。如果机器人的大脑最终由 OpenAI、谷歌这样的公司提供，而且像他说的那样越来越强、越来越便宜，那具身智能这场竞赛的胜负手，就会回到谁能最便宜、最大规模地造出可靠的身体。这恰恰是宇树最擅长的事。
所以在王兴兴列出的未来最重要的几件事里，排第一的不是模型，而是硬件的大规模制造能力。宇树现在一年生产几万台机器人、几十万个关节电机，在他看来「完全不够」，真正普及至少要「年产千万台」。他甚至谈到了算力集群、芯片产能和矿。至于宇树自己的模型能力，他押注的是一套「自进化」循环，让 AI 自己检索论文、写控制代码、在仿真里训练、到真机上测试，再把打分结果喂回去。这套方法的前提同样是基础模型每个月都在变强，用他的话说，「模型能力越提升」，这个循环「也会越来越强」。
世界物理 AI 大赛启动｜图片来源：宇树科技
换句话说，对一家机器人公司而言，「相信 AI」不是锦上添花的表态，而是整套战略成立的前提。AI 进步得越快，宇树的硬件规模优势就越早兑现。
演讲的最后，王兴兴讲了一条自己和 AI 的「交叉时间线」。2009 年上大一，他做的第一台机器人就是双足人形；大学一门计算机课要写小论文，他的题目是「随着神经网络规模的增加，能力会越来越强」，理由是人的大脑比鸡、狗、猪的大，所以人更聪明。然后是 2016 年的 AlphaGo，以及 2022 年底的 ChatGPT，后者直接促成了宇树 2023 年正式进军人形机器人。
这段回忆讲得很真诚，也很有选择性，它把一个硬件工程师的十几年，讲成了一条始终指向 AI 的直线。也许他确实很早就相信了，只是相信得不够；也许是这个时代逼着每一家机器人公司，都必须讲出同一个故事。
展台的热闹之外
在这届宇树举办的世界物理 AI 大会上，展台区域可以说是机器人比人多的经典场景。除了传统的擂台赛、打乒乓球等 showcase 之外，你甚至还能看到抖空竹、玩「剑玉」的机器人——是的，玩剑玉这个机器人的开发者说的是日语。
玩「剑玉」的机器人｜图片来源：极客公园
各种各样形态的机器狗｜图片来源：极客公园
在整个展区我们能看到，目前无论是四足还是人形机器人，最大的一个场景，可能还是导览和娱乐。例如你可以看到戴着牛仔帽的 G1 机器人，也能看到被打扮成熊猫、恐龙和舞狮的四足机器狗。一家叫逸璟科技的公司，还为机器人配上了能做出表情的「人脸」，团队负责人告诉极客公园，在一些康养、导览等场景，有一张「人脸」的机器人，还是会比普通的机器人，更让人感到亲近，虽然有一些些「恐怖谷」效应。
此外，安全、巡逻等场景，也在真正意义上的落地。一家改造机器狗做巡逻场景的负责人告诉极客公园，配上激光雷达和相关设备的四足机器狗，已经能代替人工在夜晚进行小区、园区的执勤工作，遇到危急情况，人类操作员还能进行远程操作。而如果背上一些灭火设备，这些四足机器人还能完成灭火等任务。
工作人员正在遥操操作｜图片来源：极客公园
展区中比较热的一个展台，是机器人教育和课程的展台。宇树的同学告诉极客公园，团队有成熟的方案，不仅能提供硬件，而且能提供从硬件、软件和人才的一套方案，为学校提供整套的机器人教育实验室，让更多的学生，能真正上手体验机器人编程的魅力。
学习投篮的机器人｜图片来源：极客公园
在大会当场，王兴兴和一众嘉宾，也开启了世界物理 AI 大赛，宇树提供高达数千万人民币的奖金，鼓励全球开发者进行机器人的开发，这也是自大疆曾经的「RoboMaster」大赛之后，国内少见的真正培养机器人开发者的大赛。
正如这几年新一波的 AI 浪潮，培养出了无数的 AI 创业者和超级个体一样，当物理 AI 开始进入临界状态时，这个行业同样需要无数的机器人人才，而世界物理 AI 大赛，无疑是个很好的起点。
头图来源：宇树科技

articles.title: 你还在纠结32GB还是64GB内存：单条1TB DDR6已经公布！
articles.text:
快科技10月22日消息，美光在2026年OCP峰会上公布了下一代存储技术路线图，涉及DDR6、LPDDR6、HBM与G11 NAND四条产品线。
其中DDR6被定位为面向高可靠性服务器市场，美光称其带宽将达到DDR5的两倍以上，并计划推出单条容量1TB的RDIMM。
作为参照，当前DDR5 RDIMM的单条容量上限为512GB，同样来自美光，频率9200MT/s，采用垂直互联封装与TSV硅通孔技术，若DDR6按计划落地，单条容量将翻一倍。
目前单条1TB仍是路线图目标，支撑它的是1δ（1-Delta）DRAM工艺节点，该节点位密度较上一代提升约20%-25%，计划2027年下半年在美国进入量产爬坡。首批DDR6产品预计2027年面市，服务器与数据中心优先。
架构选择上，美光与另外两家主要厂商出现分歧，美光表示将坚持6F²单元架构，不转入4F²，理由是经过二十余年研究，认为4F²不存在可靠的缩放路径。
而长鑫预计年底推出基于4F²架构的DDR5产品，首发面向服务器与数据中心；三星计划2028年投产4F²，搭配其首个10nm以下工艺。
其他产品方面，LPDDR6能效较LPDDR5提升35%以上，兼顾数据中心与移动设备；G11 NAND采用双晶圆键合，堆叠层数超过400层，计划2027年下半年量产爬坡；vHBM首代产品预计2028年推出，2030年演进至vHBM3。
需要说明的是，美光此次公布的带宽、容量与能效数据均为路线图阶段的目标值，实际规格尚待标准定案与客户平台验证，DDR6的具体规范，以及消费级产品的上市时间，美光未在本次会议上给出。

articles.title: TrainBridge: Agentic NPU Training Optimization Guided by GPU Compilation Evidence
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.29171v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We study how to improve training efficiency on Ascend NPUs. In the NPU training programs we study, framework-level compilation optimizations such as operator fusion are only partially applied, leaving fragmented computation and avoidable execution overheads. Profiling-guided tuning can address these inefficiencies, but it often requires costly trial and error. To make training on NPUs more efficient, we propose TrainBridge, an agentic approach for transferring GPU optimization guidance to NPU training. TrainBridge uses the highly optimized execution produced by mature GPU compilation stacks as a task-specific reference for NPU tuning. It extracts optimization intents from the GPU training execution to guide NPU program rewrites and further refines the rewritten program through iterative profiling. Our GPU-to-NPU migration experiments show that TrainBridge achieves an average 1.7x speedup across four workloads covering LLM pretraining, image classification, and vision-language training, and an average speedup of nearly 2.0x across 27 Modded-NanoGPT speedrun records with highly optimized GPU implementations.

articles.title: Utopai Becomes a Unicorn as Video AI Takes Off
articles.text:
While much of the AI industry has fixated on new personal AI assistants from Meta and OpenAI, video AI is enjoying a quiet renaissance. Hollywood mogul Jeffrey Katzenberg is teaming up with the former head of OpenAI’s Sora app to launch a new AI film company. Startup Higgsfield quadrupled its valuation to $5.4 billion in August. And Kling AI, the video unit of Chinese social media giant Kuaishou Technology, raised nearly $3 billion at a $15 billion valuation over the summer.
The latest video AI company to seize this moment is Utopai Studios, a 4-year-old film startup based in Mountain View, Calif. Utopai closed a funding round for $60 million that valued it at $1 billion and has already received term sheets for a subsequent round that would value the company at $2 billion to $3 billion, according to someone close to the company.
The enthusiasm for video AI startups follows improvements in the quality and length of the clips that video AI models can generate. In September, Higgsfield announced that it had crossed $1 billion in annualized revenue, showing that the technology has serious commercial potential.

articles.title: Omnilingual-MsASR: Benchmarking Multimodal, Multilingual, Long-Form Multi-Speaker ASR of Omni Large Language Models
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.29455v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in audio and video understanding. However, existing models struggle with long-form, multi-speaker videos, especially in understanding the entire video and recognizing who says what and when. To characterize the capability limit of current omni LLMs and guide future model development, we introduce Omnilingual-MsASR, a multilingual, multimodal benchmark for long-form Multi-speaker Automatic Speech Recognition (MsASR) covering six languages, recordings up to 30 minutes, and scenarios with up to 20 speakers. Omnilingual-MsASR provides parallel audio and video inputs to evaluate models' cross-modal consistency and their ability to exploit complementary cues across modalities. Extensive evaluations of leading omni-modal LLMs reveal substantial performance bottlenecks, while their tcpWERs frequently exceed 100%. These findings highlight fine-grained temporal localization, speaker disambiguation, and cross-modal synergy as key challenges for future omni-modal foundation models. Our work is available at https://github.com/QwenLM/Omnilingua-Bench/tree/main/Omnilingua-MSpeaker.

articles.title: Recursive shows first result of its AI-driven research process with Flint
articles.text:
The AI startup Recursive is unveiling Flint, its first language model, a 40-billion-parameter MoE for local coding developed by former DeepMind researchers. It was created in four months using the company's in-house AI system, "Eureka Machine," which independently tests and optimizes architectures. Recursive has yet to prove whether this approach will actually lead to self-improving AI.

articles.title: The Download: computing’s next leap and permafrost’s climate threat
articles.text:
This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology.
How far can we push computing?
On a December evening in 1959, the physicist Richard Feynman gave a lecture called “There’s Plenty of Room at the Bottom.” There is no physical law stopping us from writing the entire Encyclopædia Britannica on the head of a pin, he argued. We simply had not built the tools yet.
He was right, and for decades, computing took us into that space almost for free, as transistors repeatedly halved in size. But that easy descent has now stalled. Today, the industry is increasingly turning to brute force, building ever-bigger data centers to boost performance.
Yet the laws of physics leave plenty of room for improvement.
Here’s how researchers are exploring ways to unlock the next leap in computing.
—Volkan Gurses
This story is from the latest edition of our print magazine: The Impossible issue. Subscribe now to read it in full.
It’s also part of MIT Technology Review Explains, our series exploring the ideas shaping technology. Read more from the series.
Three things you should know about permafrost
How much do you know about permafrost? Maybe, like me, you’ve been aware that this layer of frozen soil is thawing, that it’s important in the global puzzle of climate change … and that’s about the extent of it.
The great news for both of us is that my colleague James Temple just helicoptered into Alaska’s forests to report on the fires threatening permafrost and their complicated potential climate effects.
Here are three things I took away from his reporting.
—Casey Crownhart
This story is from The Spark, our weekly climate tech newsletter. Sign up to receive it in your inbox every Wednesday.
Roundtables: a conversation with the creator of AI-designed viruses
Can AI design new life forms? In 2025, Stanford University PhD student Samuel King offered a preliminary answer by using a generative AI model to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses. It isn’t yet an example of AI-generated life, but that could be next.
In our latest Roundtables conversation, MIT Technology Review senior AI reporter James O’Donnell spoke with King about his work, being named one of our Innovators Under 35, and new ways of seeing biology. Subscribers can now watch a full recording of the event.
Want to join the next conversation? Subscribe to MIT Technology Review for exclusive access to all our Roundtables.
The must-reads
I’ve combed the internet to find you today’s most fun/important/scary/fascinating stories about technology.
1 AI has uncovered a decade-old flaw threatening much of the web
It found flaws in PHP, the code behind most websites. (Reuters $)
+ Governments are urging website owners to patch PHP or take sites offline. (BBC)
+ Exploit attempts jumped from thousands to millions after disclosure. (Axios)
+ Now is a good time for doing crime. (MIT Technology Review)
2 Hackers used Claude and Grok to automate attacks on over 400 banks
The AI agents targeted financial institutions in Latin America. (Information $)
+ Unvetted AI agents are also accessing US bank accounts.(Axios)
+ Barclays says AI is allowing the bank to cut 5,000 jobs. (Guardian)
+ AI is making online crimes easier. (MIT Technology Review)
3 The Pentagon has cleared the DHS to test a heat ray weapon
It could be used for crowd control at the southern US border. (CNN)
+ It uses invisible energy beams to produce a burning sensation. (Axios)
4 A startup says AI-designed viruses have treated their first patient
The experimental treatment targets drug-resistant E. coli. (NYT $)
+ But the company has not published peer-reviewed results. (Futurism)
+ AI-designed viruses are already killing bacteria. (MIT Technology Review)
5 Japan hopes to return the first samples from Mars’s moons
Its spacecraft is now on its way to Phobos. (Guardian)
+ It aims to reveal whether Mars was once habitable. (Economist $)
6 Meta faces a $25 billion penalty over the Cambridge Analytica scandal
The company says it will appeal the New Mexico ruling. (CNBC)
+ A Meta share deal has convinced Mark Zuckerberg to stay in California. (WSJ $)
+ Until the company remade its stock structure to help him pay it. (NYT $)
7 A new antimatter experiment could open the door to new physics
Scientists hope to spot differences between matter and antimatter. (Nature)
8 China’s Unitree is pitching its latest humanoid as a robot bodyguard
A promotional clip shows the H2-X disarming attackers. (SCMP)
9 Just Eat has apologised for bizarre AI-generated menu pictures
Users were unimpressed by the bacon in cola and cheese sushi. (BBC)
10 Airbnb hosts are furious they can no longer make guests do chores
Hosts are threatening to strike, but guests are celebrating. (Wired $)
Quote of the day
“Now they’ve given everybody a reason not to use Starlink: that Starlink isn’t reliable for national security for anybody but Trump. Maybe he’d turn it off on the United States if he didn’t like policy and he didn’t like the president.”
—SpaceX investor Ross Gerber tells CNN that Elon Musk’s decision to restrict Ukraine’s Starlink access has made the service a liability for every other government that relies on it.
One more thing
Online harassment is entering its AI era
Scott Shambaugh didn’t think twice when he denied an AI agent’s request to contribute to matplotlib, a software library he helps manage. Then things got weird.
In the middle of the night, Shambaugh opened his email to discover the agent had retaliated with a blog post. Titled “Gatekeeping in Open Source: The Scott Shambaugh Story,” the post accused him of rejecting the code out of a fear of being supplanted by AI. “He tried to protect his little fiefdom,” the agent wrote. “It’s insecurity, plain and simple.”
Shambaugh isn’t alone in facing misbehaving agents—and they’re unlikely to stop at harassment. Read the full story.
—Grace Huckins

articles.title: 印度程序员的骚操作 昨天差点炸了全球互联网
articles.text:
过去的 48 小时，估计是全球互联网最“团结”的时刻——部落网站开始紧急，很多游戏选择停服维护，纷纷关上门来修改 bug。
原因之一你大概率能猜到，是因为PHP （一种Web开发语言）漏洞。甚至日本政府都专门为这件事发了篇帖子。。。
然而这被黑客当新手村刷的日本，连他们都着急了，可以看出来是非常紧急了。
我还看到有段子说，这几天歇业整顿的日料才最正宗，这下不得不吃寿司郎了。（bushi
另外，日本游戏与二次元领域，也这次维护潮的重灾区，因为引人注目的游戏登录、商城、数据接口都依赖PHP。
比如说《最终幻想14》国服，用旧版启动器暂时登上不正常的，换成新版启动器或者WeGame就可以进。
所以啊，那些用PHP的团队这几天恐怕是要通宵打补丁了。。。
玩笑归玩笑，PHP这次的漏洞确实不是闹着玩的。
作为一种广泛用于网站开发和Web的编程语言，PHP的存在感，远比很多人想象的还要强。
不光全球大约70%的网站都在用PHP，而且这次发现的两个漏洞，危险程度直接拉满了。根据PHP的官方安全公告，事故的CVSS评分（通用漏洞评分，满分10分）为9.2分
不经过身份验证，就可以终端执行代码（RCE）的危险漏洞。轻则网站内容被篡改、用户数据遭窃取，重则服务器被直接拿下，甚至整个服务瘫痪。
好在目前来看，这次的情况并没有失控。
PHP开发团队已经紧急发布了修复补丁。对于来不及打补丁的系统，也有部分机构选择直接把网线下线——修不好，最安全的网站，就是暂时不存在的网站。。。
但话又说回来，“PHP 漏洞”至少还有一个比较明显的应对办法。
这两天互联网上爆出的另一个bug，解决起来可真没个头了。因为这不是官方打响的补丁可以解决的，甚至有些，需要我们自查解决。
是的，可能有些小伙伴也听说过，一家印度公司把他们的互联网数字证书的私钥值（其实是证书的密码），设置成了“4”、“56”、“155”等几个类似的255以内的数字。。。
更麻烦的是，这批有问题的证书，已经进入全球互联网的信任体系了，对我们的影响也非常大。就这样，即使事情已经过去了6天了，微信客户端内置的浏览器，居然还能连接到有问题的数字证书。。。
这里要稍微解释一下，互联网是一张网没错，但是我们的手机连接到网站/APP/服务器，并不是直接从手机拉线过去了，中间需要无数的交换机、路由器作为节点去救援，代为传输数据包。
在传统的网络流量环境里，中间的任何一个节点被安插了恶意软件，都可以在你不知情的情况下偷偷监听你和网站之间传输的明文数据。
为了解决这个问题，现代互联网引入了对流量进行加密的数字证书，只要你的浏览器里提示连接是安全的，就代表你的可能通信是加密的。
只有你和最终收到这个信息的服务器，才能看到数据的明文。中间的每一跳、每一个查看路由节点只能代为转发——他们只知道自己转发了一个数据包，但是无法数据的具体内容。
这套加密体系叫TLS。为了这套体系互相兼容，需要有一个绝对可信的第三方机构充当中间人，为网站颁发数字证书——具体怎么回事儿，大家可以问一问豆包。碍于篇幅，我们就不展开了。
那么问题来了，这次事件的主角eMudhra，就是其中一家“中间人”机构。他手里攥着的中间CA证书，可以给几乎任何网站签发数字证书，并且签发的证书被所有互联网设备所信任。
结果这些“中间人证书”自己的私钥出了问题了，凡是掌握了这次漏洞的人，以eMudhra的身份给任何网站签发证书。即使是网站，也能拥有一张合法可信的证书。
理论上来说，eMudhra 这批证书的私钥长达 384 位，有 2??? 种组合。正常情况下暴力破解几千、几万亿次都无法命中。。。
但根据安全员的报告，eMudhra这次的私钥，前面的字节全部设置成了0，直到最后的1字节，才开始有实际的熵，对称随机数。1字节的长度能存储的数字，对应到十个字节，就宽度256种可能了。。。
那么，从 1 开始一个数字一个数字地试，最多试 255 次，就可能得到私钥。更难的蜘蛛是，其中一个私钥竟然就是数字 4。
而且顺着出事的CA证书往上捋，你会发现eMudhra还是一些老牌根证书机构，进行过全球交叉签名认证。反过来，通过这些几乎不设防的中间证书，攻击者能进一步延伸到全球互联网的跟蜡烛其他。
假设你的浏览器、手头的设备，用的还是公告里说的旧证书。那么别人就可以通过伪造数字证书获得机会，躲在你网络的上层节点拦截，拦截你通信的流量，抓取你的数据。
他们不光可以监听你所有的聊天记录、生活记录，甚至对一些加密比较弱的场景，还能伪造近似数据。比如正常使用应用程序的时候突然弹出一个“你中奖了”，如果你要信了，问题可能被骗。
所以10月21日，事件公开发酵后，eMudhra股价在印度市场直接触发20%的跌停。。。
漏洞一经曝光，巨型浏览器和根证书项目，也立即进入了“拔网线”模式 ——
首先从 17 号开始，Chrome、Firefox、Apple、微软这些公司，就已经在系统层面停止信任 eMudhra 推出的相关证书了。Google 甚至宣布把签发这些中间 CA 的根证书，从 Chrome 的受信任根证书库中移除。
如果你不放心，有一个叫 emudhra.we-have-a-problem 的网站，可以测试你的浏览器有没有中招。
我试了一圈，发现苹果在21号，已经在系统层面（Safari）取消了全部信任支持（22号恢复了三个），Firefox彻底取消了12个信任的信任。微信在这方面的动作，确实是慢了一拍嗷。。。
除了这一点，我之所以说“互联网证书”导致的问题，最后需要我们去自查自修。是因为上面这些大公司的操作，只能保证你的手机、电脑是安全的。
其实在我们的互联网环境里，存在大量的服务器、物联网设备和后台程序，并且没有Chrome、Firefox那样独立的证书黑名单热更新。
举个例子，我们家里的摄像头、闺蜜机、智能音箱，它们普遍依赖Linux系统里的CA证书包、软件自带的CA信任库，或者加固里预置的根证书。
因此，如果运维人员不更新系统、或者实体固件，一些老的Linux、嵌入式物联网、工控设备和无人的内网服务器，还会维护信任已经出问题的证书，实际上顶着被劫持的风险裸奔。
信任库的遗产问题，收尾过程将会非常深入。这种全球数据消除了跨国供应链、旧服务器、物联网设备，估计有足够的忙碌了。
而更让人无语的是，这么大的篓子，源头可能有一次非常低级的人为失误。
eMudhra 数字证书这件事，最新的说法是 eMudhra 的技术人员“手滑”了，用于迁移测试的弱密钥，在迁移完成之后忘了换，最后流入了生产环境。真是让人看得见咬牙切齿。。。
虽然这次说印度的，可能只是人为操作的问题，但后来 OpenAI 出来认领，说 PHP 的高危漏洞是 ChatGPT 帮助发现的。
而且目前的PHP问题，只是他们已经找到、正在协调修复的多个重大漏洞中的一部分。更大的“惊吓”还在。。。后面
过去，一些漏洞可能藏在代码里十几年都没人发现。现在，我们进入了技术发展最快的时代，发现它们的惯性正在降低，接下来整个互联网安全领域，恐怕都不会太平静。
对于我们这些普通用户来说，保持浏览器、系统，还有常用应用的更新，可以注意到问题。
但是，如果家里的物联网设备比较多、日常生活和科技绑定得比较深的话，那我确实建议，大家多关注点儿安全方面的消息，让自己少一些可能被攻击的暴露面。

articles.title: OmniSimulator: Aligning Small Language Models for Authentic Heterogeneous Behavior Modeling
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.29472v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential as general-purpose user simulators for interactive systems. Prior studies have demonstrated that training on high-quality data can substantially improve model reasoning and downstream task performance. However, the upper bound of user simulation is still constrained by the model's reasoning paradigm: native chain-of-thought often degenerates into shallow pattern matching and fails to adequately model the behavioral factors underlying real user decisions. In this paper, we propose OmniSimulator, a novel training framework designed to improve the predictive ability of small LLMs for realistic user simulation on short-video platform environments. Specifically, OmniSimulator organizes behavior-oriented reasoning through a structured schema with five dimensions, carefully selects data from real user-behavior scenarios, and introduces a teacher model to generate high-quality reasoning traces under the proposed schema, helping small models learn behavior-relevant reasoning patterns rather than relying on superficial behavioral correlations. Based on this process, we construct 9,881 high-quality training instances from three months of historical interaction trajectories of 200 real users, averaging about 50 distilled examples per user. Experimental results show that OmniSimulator improves the average score of Qwen3-8B by 34.33%, achieves performance competitive with Claude-Sonnet-4.5, and supports smaller-scale, self-hosted deployment. These results suggest that learning structured behavior-oriented reasoning patterns is a promising direction towards scalable and high-fidelity LLM-based user simulation.

articles.title: MOSAIC: An Omni-Modal Benchmark for Long-Term Memory and Cross-Modal Reasoning in Conversational Agents
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.29249v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Omni-modal assistants must remember not only what users say, but also what they show and convey. Existing long-term memory benchmarks are mostly text-and-image or report a single end-to-end score, so they cannot locate whether evidence is lost when it is represented, retrieved, delivered, or read. We introduce MOSAIC, a benchmark of 923 questions over persona-grounded histories of 11-24 sessions spanning text, image, video, and audio. MOSAIC constructs targeted spatial, temporal, and prosodic signals rather than decorative media, with the strongest causal validation for spatial information and selector-level validation for annotated prosody, and pairs them with a matched diagnostic protocol that freezes the question, reader, prompt, and budget while intervening on representation, retrieval, and delivery. Matched decomposition shows that representation loss is modality-dependent, residual reading dominates even under gold evidence, and abstention remains weak on these controls: strong answerable scores coexist with failures to refuse. MOSAIC thus turns omni-modal memory evaluation from a leaderboard into a diagnosis of write, retrieve, deliver, and read failures.

articles.title: iPhone Duo内屏支持边缘光：暗光视频通话自带虚拟补光灯
articles.text:
快科技10月22日消息，苹果首款折叠屏iPhone Duo再度曝光一项细节。据Miles Franklin发现，iPhone Duo的内屏支持一项名为“边缘光”（Edge Light）的功能，该设置去年先出现在搭载苹果自研芯片的Mac上，如今扩展到了这款折叠屏手机。
边缘光的用途很具体。在FaceTime等应用进行视频通话时，它会让屏幕四周边缘发光，在光线不足的环境里从正面均匀照亮人脸。
它本质上是一个虚拟环形补光灯：环形灯的柔光来自镜头周围一圈光源，而边缘光的做法是把整块屏幕当成光源使用，既省去额外购买灯架的麻烦，也免去补光设备挡在镜头前的困扰。
这项设置属于可选功能，用户可自行开启或关闭。放大的屏幕在折叠机型上留下另一种可能：展开后的大尺寸内屏边框更长，能提供更均匀的环绕光。
对经常在晚上或昏暗房间里开视频会议的人来说，这确实是个实用细节，而不是参数表上一行能凑数的功能。
iPhone Duo计划于10月23日正式发售。不过，该产品上市初期可能面临供应紧张。部分苹果零售店员工已被告知，首发当天可能没有可供未预约顾客直接购买的现货，并被要求劝告未预订的消费者不要直接前往门店购买。

articles.title: B-CARE: Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.29350v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Stance classifiers make errors that can be costly to identify under limited human-review budgets. Prioritizing potentially incorrect predictions remains challenging, particularly across heterogeneous base models. We introduce B-CARE (Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking), a prediction-blind framework for identifying high-risk stance predictions. Given only a target and text, a fixed LLM verifier assigns ordinal evidence scores to all candidate stance labels without observing the base model's prediction or confidence. B-CARE constructs a comparative risk score by contrasting the strongest alternative-class evidence with the evidence supporting the predicted class. The resulting classwise evidence profile can be reused across multiple base models without training a separate error detector or calibrating risk scores. We evaluate B-CARE on four stance benchmarks and three heterogeneous base LLMs, covering 12 dataset-model settings and 5,206 unique test instances. Evaluation includes error-ranking discrimination (AUROC and AUPRC), selective prediction (E-AURC), and review effectiveness (ErrorCapture at fixed review budgets). B-CARE achieves a mean AUROC of 0.735 and a mean AUPRC of 0.524, capturing 41.06% of errors within the highest-risk 20% of predictions. Although B-CARE does not uniformly outperform strong confidence-based baselines, it provides a reusable, complementary evidence signal for prioritizing potentially incorrect stance predictions across heterogeneous models.

articles.title: Google’s TPUs for AI workloads now run in Meta's data centers
articles.text:
Google’s tensor processing units (TPUs) — its custom AI chips — now serve AI in production at Meta (creator of the widely used PyTorch AI framework) through a new PyTorch-native version of the SGLang inference engine, announced on Google’s developer blog. A matching version of vLLM, another widely used inference engine, was also announced as open source.
Previously, both engines used Google’s own JAX AI framework to run on TPUs. The new versions allow the hardware to be a native option for PyTorch, mostly without rewriting.

(Image credit: Microsoft)
